name: python-openapi-client
title: Python OpenAPI client
blurb: A client that reads its OpenAPI document at run time and validates both directions: the request body before it is sent, and the response against the schema for that exact status - an undocumented status is drift, not something to skip
default_description: A stdlib-only HTTP client that fails loudly when the server drifts from its OpenAPI document.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --quiet --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --quiet --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

verify.name: drift-exits-1
verify.cmd: p=$(.venv/bin/python -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0)); print(s.getsockname()[1]); s.close()'); .venv/bin/python fixtures/server.py --port "$p" --drift >/dev/null 2>&1 & pid=$!; for i in $(seq 1 50); do .venv/bin/python -c 'import socket,sys; s=socket.socket(); sys.exit(0 if s.connect_ex(("127.0.0.1", int(sys.argv[1]))) == 0 else 1)' "$p" && break; sleep 0.1; done; set +e; .venv/bin/python -m {{ package_name }} --base-url "http://127.0.0.1:$p" call listNotes >/dev/null 2>&1; s=$?; kill $pid 2>/dev/null; test "$s" -eq 1

detect.contains: the response does not fit the document
